ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'So whither do you stray?' in Surah Al-Infitar?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Infitar, this rhetorical question underscores the existential disorientation of those who reject divine signs, highlighting the contrast between their chaotic path and the orderly cosmic order. Shia exegetes often view this as a warning against spiritual deviation, emphasizing that straying from the Fitrah (innate nature) leads to inevitable accountability. The verse serves as a poignant reminder of the transient nature of worldly pursuits compared to the eternal reality of the Hereafter.
